scope: Every image in this folder shows the same deployed candidate. Normal-browser frames prove fallback and human interaction; Chrome 152 frames prove page-native WebMCP execution.

normalBrowser.expectedBoundary: The page stays usable and reports Site tools not detected. This lane may emit Chrome's experimental tools origin-trial warning; it is not counted as a product error.

images.action: Open the live no-login route in the default light theme.
images.claim: The first view is a quiet national atlas and the normal-browser fallback remains usable.

images.action: Search Springfield and submit without a state.
images.claim: Atlas returns eight deliberate candidates and states that the map is unchanged.

images.action: Repeat the ambiguous Springfield search at the exact mobile acceptance viewport.
images.claim: Ambiguity recovery remains readable with no horizontal overflow and 44px candidate actions.

images.action: Open the live route with dark color-scheme emulation.
images.claim: The field-atlas hierarchy and land-water contrast survive dark mode without generic glowing UI.

images.action: Press Tab until the place finder receives keyboard focus in dark mode.
images.claim: Keyboard focus is visibly distinct without depending on color alone.

images.action: Invoke add_map_note, then create_map_trail for Riverside, Miami-Dade, and Travis counties.
images.claim: The completed national route, three numbered markers, editable notebook rail, visible note, and agent activity are present before tool success.

images.action: After the agent-created trail, use the human rail control to open stop 2.
images.claim: The map, breadcrumb, and rail agree on Miami-Dade as the current stop through the shared controller.

images.action: Emulate prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and create the same three-stop trail.
images.claim: The complete route remains legible while route, marker, pin, active-ring, and activity animations compute to none.
